(Instagram) Spoiler warning: If you are yet to watch ' VisionQuest ,' discretion is advised, as this article contains spoilers. Ahead of the release of ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ next month, Marvel gave fans a chance to catch up with their superheroes, with thousands of screenings of ‘Avengers: Endgame Encore’ held across the world. The re-release was a massive success and even included brand-new clips to give a little insight into the events that will happen in the upcoming MCU film. Now, fans will be able to catch the re-release version of the Marvel release online. Here is all you need to know about the OTT release of ‘Avengers: Endgame Encore.’ Here is all you need to know about the OTT release of ‘Avengers: Endgame Encore.' When and where to watch ‘Avengers: Endgame Encore’?
 The special edition of ‘Endgame’ will officially be released worldwide on Disney +. The epic film is slated to make its way to the platform on November 13, Friday, ahead of the official release of ‘Avengers: Doomsday’. Plot of ‘Avengers: Endgame Encore’
 The conclusion to the Infinity Saga, the film starts five years after Thanos’ snap and the devastating event that followed when half the world’s population was wiped out. The remainder of the Avengers try to cope with the situation and turn to their own inhibitions. However, when Ant-Man returns, having been presumed dead, new hope arises for the team. They try again to change the course of history and defend the world against Thanos in another showdown. The re-release contained bonus footage and key ‘Doomsday’ teasers for fans when it was released in theatres worldwide back in September. According to Sacnilk data, along with the help of the re-release, the MCU film has now grossed USD 2.9 billion, making it the highest-earning film in the franchise, followed closely by ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day' and ‘Avengers: Infinity War.’ A TV spot titled ‘Countdown to Doomsday’ was also released online along with the announcement of ‘Encore’s OTT release. The spot shares clips from many of the MCU films released in the past couple of years along with the caption, “Return to the universe.” About ‘Avengers: Doomsday’
 Different groups of superheroes from the MCU are coming together for the upcoming film to defeat one common evil, Dr Doom/Victor Von Doom, who is from the same universe as the ‘Fantastic Four’ and is one of the most powerful enemies the superheroes will ever face. This film will bring together the Wakandans from Black Panther, the Thunderbolts from Earth-616, the Fantastic Four from Earth-828, and the original X-Men. This is Patrick Stewart’s final film that he completed before his passing. The MCU also teased another possible fan favourite return to the franchise with the finale of their series, 'VisionQuest.' The show ends by showing clips of the Scarlet Witch sacrificing herself in ‘Doctor Strange: Multiverse of Madness’. However, the scene is not the end, as a boulder that had fallen over her shows Dr Doom standing there and looking at her, saying, “Your powers will be mine." The scene ends with the Scarlet Witch abruptly opening her eyes, which have turned green. ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ will release in theatres worldwide on December 18.
